main_text.l: producatur materia. An autem arthriticis
propinandum uinum sit non pauci medici
dubitant. Qui exhibendum esse censent, ru-
brum crassum albo tenui anteferunt. Nos
autem, quod album est & tenue, oligopho-
rum, & maturum esse potui dandum iudi-
camus, eo quòd diureticum sit, humoresq;
ferosos, qui per uenas in debiliores articu-
los profluere consueuerunt, euacuet, ac a-
uertat. Caetera autem uinorum genera ma-
gnum arthriticis facessunt negotiū, quòd
& sanguinem magis magisq; augeant, &
fluxiliorem reddant. Posthaec ad ea, quae al
teram arthritidis causam, nempe articulo-
rum imbecillitatem expungunt, nobis pro-
gredi licet. Illius autem, quae acquisita est,
necingenita, hic nobis fermo est: cuius ut
plures sunt causae, ita & plura praesidia. Id-
circo quae ab immoderata & intempestiva
uenere est, continentia discutitur. Propte-
rea nonnulli omnimodā ipsius ueneris ab-
stinentiam commendant. Ob id obscoena-
rum, uiriliumque partium abscisionem, &
omnibus arthriticis, & praesertim uegetis
& iuuenibus imperant. Verum quoniam
humanae speciei, quae ueneris usu conserva-
tur, nimia foret iniuria, idcirco ab eo tam
sequero

page.notes: Catchword "sequero" is printed at the foot right, after the last line; the text ends with the last full line "tam", so the catchword is kept only in its element. Last line is partly obscured by a stain at "iniuria" and "conserva-tur" on the left edge. Some words may have printing irregularities (e.g. "sequero" as catchword written "fequero" in the scan) and are copied as printed. Long s throughout is rendered as s. The line "Nos autem" etc. follows the printed text. The foot paragraph is empty and should be removed on review.
